title: pycreus flavidus var. nilagiricus
intro: Pycreus flavidus var. nilagiricus, commonly known as Nilagiri sedge, is a plant species in the sedge family (Cyperaceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties and is valued for its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial activities. The therapeutic actions of Nilagiri sedge include its potential to reduce fever, alleviate respiratory issues, and support the immune system. The bioactive constituents of Pycreus flavidus var. nilagiricus include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties and health benefits.
